title: Mixed cyclic product with an exact noise-shell admission certificate

claims.statement: The explicit product of six [300,150] three-field components and one [200,100] two-field component, with the fixed adaptive decoder in proof.md, has average block error at most 13699779932857317/15625000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10).
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=8361251488734102 primitives on any received word, with W<=2^(52893/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check shared QR spectra, exact adaptive work and weight-shell admission, and the mixed cumulative-occupancy error certificate.
